description: The pages of the main window and of the task windows may run operations of the catalog through `op`, receive change events through `subscribe`, signal their first screen, check spelling in the editor, attach files the person chooses or drops (the page names the task, never a path), open or save a copy of an attached file through the system, save an export of the list where the person chooses, export to an archive and import one that the person chooses in the native file chooser (the page names projects and a token, never a path), open a web or mail address in the desktop's browser or mail program, receive in the main window the tasks of links handed to the running app, open a task in its own window, read and change the app's own settings (background mode and notifications) and the person's time zone, list the time zones to choose from, and keep the page's own preferences for the next start, show the quick-add window, read and change the desktop-wide quick-add shortcut, quit the app (also in background mode), set their title, and move, minimize, maximize and close their own window, for the header bar. Nothing else of Tauri's API is reachable from the page.
